items.summary: Recommendation: preserve containment-only execution this cycle. Do not create proposals, work items, change requests, experiments, telemetry, deployments, spend, or requeues. Prioritize these later by operator time saved, reliability, reversibility, adoption, and measurable outcome. Continue existing repair, validation, rollback, attribution reconciliation, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Keep private launch gates unchanged and do not invent telemetry. created_by=product-manager-fleet
